references.text: Describes various forms of uncleanness resulting from touching unclean things, including unclean animals and human impurity that renders a person unclean.
Concerns the uncleanness that comes from touching carcasses of unclean animals.
Deals with uncleanness arising from human bodily discharges, which is one of the types of uncleanness mentioned in Leviticus 7:21.
Priests who are unclean must not eat of the holy offerings, paralleling the prohibition against eating peace offerings while in a state of uncleanness.
Describes uncleanness resulting from touching dead bodies, a form of human impurity.
The preceding verse which also speaks about being cut off from the people for eating peace offerings while unclean.
First use of the expression 'cut off from his people' in connection with covenant violation.
Describes the peace offering (זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים) mentioned in the verse.
List of unclean animals (בְּהֵמָה טְמֵאָה) referred to.
